svg.title: GLOBALS mark: do not
svg.text: The fourteen things never done with the mark (chapter 2), and the four modes that are the only correct ones. The supplied files are the only source; never rebuild, recolour or decorate them.
No citric knot, no sky wordmark, no two-tone.
2. Gradient on the knot or wordmark
The meshes are for display type and strips.
On a photo use a scrim, not an effect.
Knot and wordmark ≥ 4.5:1 on any ground.

g.text: 72 px wide: below the 120 px floor

svg.text: Lockup floor 120 px / 30 mm; knot 16 px / 5 mm.
Never both lockups on one surface.

g.text: wordmark set in Urbanist, not the artwork

svg.text: The lockup is artwork, not a word.
Never in different corners of one surface.

g.text: type inside the 1 G clear space

svg.text: 1 G on all sides, from the outermost ink.
Do: one of the four modes, nothing else
Gold on dark is the primary mode.
Numbers refer to the "Do not" list in chapter 2. The list is closed: a misuse not drawn here is still a misuse when it breaks a stated rule.
